method: Direct Google US-English SERPs and autocomplete in an anonymous browser; supplementary web search; primary career, employer and training pages. AX observations retained beside this file. selectionRule: Choose accurate, recognizable professional terminology and informational coverage. Autocomplete and related questions suggest intent, not measured popularity. Employer frequency is never a search-demand proxy.
